description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Amentum is hiring a C/C++ Software Developer to support software development and integration for Naval projects in Dahlgren, Virginia. The role contributes to software development for the Submarine Launched Ballistic Missile weapon system and other Naval programs, working with engineering teams using Agile principles.
C/C++ software developer integrating Agile applications for submarine-launched ballistic missile weapon systems

Responsibilities:
• Perform software development and integration using C/C++ in support of Naval projects and programs
• Conduct software development within the Submarine Launched Ballistic Missile (SLBM) weapon system
• Primarily support a Senior Amentum developer in development using Agile development principles
• Apply knowledge and experience with C and C++ in support of software development activities
• Perform analysis and problem-solving techniques in support of professional scientific and engineering work
• Work independently and with others within established teams and across organizations to meet established goals within schedule-driven timelines

Requirements:
• software development-related education and/or experience
• 0–10 years of experience
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, physics, mathematics, engineering, or another applicable technical field, or equivalent experience in lieu of the education requirement
• Familiarity with Agile Development
• Successful candidates must possess excellent communication skills and be able to interact directly with customers and engineering personnel
• Must have an active Secret U.S. Government clearance
• U.S. citizenship is required to maintain a Secret clearance
• Candidate must maintain a valid REAL ID driver's license

Preferred:
• Experience across multiple programming languages, including C and C++
• A mathematics background is a plus
• Experience with Git/Jenkins is also a plus
